exclusions.description: Running chapter titles and printed page numbers on document pages 391–425 are nonindexable navigation furniture.
Brief named travelers and quoted witnesses are excluded as standalone required subjects where they only illustrate a broader analytical treatment.
Local places used only for a single statistic or example are not independently required subjects in this chapter-level discovery.
Adjacent chapter pages389–390 belong to CHUNK-016; they are not duplicate CHUNK-017 evidence. The principal reviewed them fully under their owner.

uncertainties.description: The counterfactual argument distinguishes continuity or altered timing from distinctive ideological,religious,military and cultural transformations. Preserve both sides.
Closing human-cost figures are authorial aggregate estimates spanning revolutionary and Napoleonic periods; distinguish them from independently verified demographic totals.

Separate civil rights for free people of colour,abolition,and Saint-Domingue autonomy/reconquest preserve different populations and outcomes. Global consolidation with earlier colonial requirements remains queued.
